Container.Name: unire
Container.Overview: Self-hosted control panel for AI coding agents. Start a coding task from the browser; it runs in its own disposable Docker sandbox on your repos and pushes a branch when it finishes. Single owner, one login. This container controls Docker on this server through the socket, so keep it on your private network and read docs/deploy.md first.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and master key. Back this up.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets Unire start sandbox containers. This is root-level access to Docker on this server.

Config.Name: Master key (optional)
Config.Description: 64 hex characters. If set, the key that encrypts saved tokens is not stored in the data folder.

Config.Name: Sandbox image
Config.Description: Image used for each coding session.
